root_cause: snat port exhaustion on the cluster's outbound load balancer
exhausted snat ports on the standard load balancer outbound ip
allocatedoutboundports 0 leaves the default 1024 ports per node
default 1024 snat ports per node are exhausted by connection churn
no http keep-alive in the payments api http client
each partner call opens a new outbound connection
fix: switch the cluster outbound type to a managed nat gateway
configure a nat gateway for the aks subnet
raise allocatedoutboundports in the load balancer profile
